### A Overlooked Treasure City – "Millennium Dragon Hometown" Puyang

Autumn in Puyang features clear skies and light clouds, making it perfect for a city stroll to experience the millennium-old charm and modern vitality of this "Chinese Dragon Hometown." 🍂 Puyang Autumn Travel Guide: Journey Through the Millennium Dragon Hometown, Enjoy the Ancient Charm and Autumn Scenery ✨ Highlights · Explore the "Chinese Dragon Hometown": Visit the birthplace of the "China’s First Dragon" and trace the origins of Chinese civilization. · Enjoy Autumn Scenery: Admire Puyang’s unique autumn beauty in wetland parks and ecological areas. · Experience Acrobatics Charm: Watch spectacular acrobatic performances in the world-famous "Hometown of Acrobatics." 🗓️ Basic Information Best time to visit: October to November, when Puyang enjoys crisp autumn air and comfortable temperatures.

Recommended duration: 2-3 days Transportation: Puyang East Station is a key stop on the Beijing-Hong Kong High-Speed Railway, with direct trains to Zhengzhou, Jinan, Beijing, and other major cities; within the city, you can use buses, taxis, or shared bikes. 🗺️ Selected Attractions and Themed Routes The Puyang Municipal Culture and Tourism Department thoughtfully offers multiple themed routes, which you can mix and match based on your interests and time.
The table below summarizes some of the best autumn routes.

Theme Category | Route Highlights | Suitable For ---|---|--- Cultural Exploration Tour | Puyang Museum → Qicheng Park → Birthplace of China’s First Dragon → Sipailou (Ancient Cross Street) → Cangjie Mausoleum Cultural Tourism Area | History lovers, cultural explorers Ecological Leisure Tour | Longshan Longhu Tourism Resort → Puyang Shangyuan → Green Manor → Puyang Water Park → Jindi River National Wetland Park | Family trips, nature enthusiasts Acrobatics Magic Tour | Dongbeizhuang Acrobatics Cultural Park → Water Show International Grand Theatre (watch the "Water Show" performance) | Unique experience seekers, families with children 🏛️ Cultural Exploration Tour: Touching Millennium History 1.

Qicheng Ruins Park: An important city of the State of Wei during the Spring and Autumn period, with well-preserved rammed earth walls and an alliance platform that lets you almost hear the echoes of ancient feudal lords’ meetings.
The park is free to enter and houses the Qicheng Exhibition Hall displaying artifacts including the "China’s First Dragon." 2.
Puyang Museum: A perfect place to quickly understand Puyang’s civilization from ancient times to today.
It holds over 5,500 artifacts, with the "China’s First Dragon" as its crown jewel.
Free admission, closed on Mondays. 3.
Sipailou (Ancient Cross Street): Stroll along the bluestone pavement and feel the bustling life of old Puyang.
Traditional buildings and long-established shops around showcase the charm of the old city. 4.
Cangjie Mausoleum Cultural Tourism Area: Located in Nanle County, this sacred site commemorates Cangjie, the legendary inventor of Chinese characters.
The solemn ancient architecture lets you feel the mystery and greatness of the origin of Chinese writing. 🌳 Ecological Leisure Tour: Enjoy Autumn Scenery 1.
Puyang Shangyuan: One of Puyang’s largest ecological wetland parks.
In autumn, the park is colorful with lakes and mountains complementing each other.
You can cycle, stroll, or boat on the lake to enjoy a leisurely time.
Free admission. 2.
Longshan Park: Formed by earth excavated from Longhu Lake, stretching 6,400 meters, symbolizing the 6,400-year history of the Chinese dragon.
The park is lush with greenery and displays a "red leaves in full bloom" scene in autumn.
It has fitness trails and equipment, ideal for relaxation and exercise. 3.
Puyang Water Park: Early autumn here is lush and picturesque, an ideal spot to appreciate Puyang’s green development achievements. 4.
Jindi River National Wetland Park: A vast wetland with rich ecological resources, home to many bird species and aquatic plants.
Autumn is a great season for birdwatching and enjoying natural scenery. 🎪 Acrobatics and Special Experiences 1.
Water Show International Grand Theatre: Don’t miss a "Water Show" performance, which combines acrobatics, dance, music, magic, and more with stunning stage effects.
It’s recommended to check showtimes and buy tickets in advance via the official WeChat account. 2.

Dongbeizhuang Acrobatics Cultural Park: Known as the "Hometown of Chinese Acrobatics," here you can enjoy amazing acrobatic shows, visit the Central Plains Acrobatics Museum, explore the Acrobatics Courtyard, and interact face-to-face with folk artists. 3.
Puyang Water Town: A unique town integrating leisure, entertainment, shopping, and dining.
The night light show is beautiful, children can wear Hanfu for free photos, and watch folk performances. 🍜 Featured Food Recommendations 1.
Zhuangmo: A representative traditional noodle dish in Puyang, with a crispy crust and tender filling, large and filling.
Recommended is "Wang Ji Zhuangmo" in the old city. 2.
Pickled Fish: Made using traditional marinating methods, the fish is tender with a rich pickled aroma. 3.
Wrapped Liangpi: Chewy cold noodles served with cucumber strips, gluten, and topped with special sesame sauce and chili oil, refreshing and appetizing. 4.

Pucheng Huaji Soup: Fresh pork tenderloin sliced thinly or shredded, coated with starch and cooked in soup, delicious and smooth in texture. 📝 Practical Itinerary Planning One-Day Highlights Tour · Morning: Visit Qicheng Ruins Park to learn about Puyang’s long history. · Noon: Taste local specialties Zhuangmo and Pickled Fish. · Afternoon: Explore Puyang Shangyuan and enjoy autumn nature. · Evening: Head to Water Show Street for night views and acrobatic performances.

Two-Day Deep Tour Day 1 · Morning: Puyang Museum → Qicheng Ruins Park · Noon: Try Wrapped Liangpi and Pucheng Huaji Soup · Afternoon: Sipailou (Ancient Cross Street) → Longshan Park · Evening: Watch the "Water Show" at Water Show International Grand Theatre Day 2 · Morning: Visit Dongbeizhuang, Acrobatics Cultural Park, and Wildlife Park · Noon: Dine in Dongbeizhuang or return to the city · Afternoon: Leisure tour of Puyang Shangyuan or Green Manor · Evening: Stroll Puyang Water Town, enjoy night views and folk performances 💰 Budget Estimate (Per Person) Item | Budget (CNY) | Comfortable (CNY) ---|---|--- Accommodation (per night) | 150-300 | 300-600 Meals (per day) | 50-100 | 100-200 Transportation (city per day) | 20-50 | 50-100 Tickets (main attractions) | Mostly free, acrobatics 100-300 | Mostly free, acrobatics 200-400 Miscellaneous (per day) | 50-100 | 100-200 💡 Useful Tips 1.
Weather and Clothing: Autumn in Puyang is comfortable but with a big temperature difference between day and night; bring a light jacket. 2.
Booking Info: Puyang Museum is closed on Mondays; check showtimes and book tickets for the Water Show in advance via the official WeChat account. 3.
Transportation Advice: Use buses or taxis within the city; for county attractions like Cangjie Mausoleum, self-driving or chartered cars are recommended. 4.
Special Experiences: Autumn offers picking activities; ecological farms provide hands-on mushroom picking and lighting fun. 5.
Photography Tips: The ancient walls and autumn leaves at Qicheng Ruins Park, the lake and autumn colors at Puyang Shangyuan, and the old street charm of Sipailou are excellent photography subjects.
Autumn in Puyang offers profound historical heritage, splendid natural scenery, and unique acrobatic culture.
We hope this guide helps you create unforgettable autumn memories in this ancient city.

### Henan | Pushui Ancient Town | A Symphony of Opera and Time
Pushui Ancient Town, located in the south new district of Puyang County, Henan Province, covers an area of over 6,000 mu and is a national 4A-level scenic spot.

Centered around opera culture, it integrates the historical heritage of the Central Plains with architectural styles from multiple dynasties, creating a complex cultural tourism town that combines cultural experiences, leisure and entertainment, and ecological sightseeing.

The grandeur of the Qin and Han dynasties, the elegance of the Jiangnan region, and the charm of the Republican era intertwine here, complemented by intangible cultural heritage performances and modern commercial facilities, making it a "living cultural museum" in the Central Plains.🌿 --- Travel Guide 🗺️ **Must-See Experiences**: 1. **Architectural Journey Through Time**: Stroll through the Ming and Qing memorial archways, the Tang-style opera house, and the Republican-era streets, experiencing the architectural aesthetics of "a thousand years in one town." The small bridges and flowing water of the Jiangnan gardens contrast sharply with the simplicity of the northern Henan dwellings, making it ideal for Hanfu photography. 2. **Intangible Cultural Heritage Feast**: Puyang Daxiang Opera, Mulian Opera, and other intangible cultural heritage performances are staged daily at fixed times.

The nighttime light show uses ancient buildings as a backdrop to showcase Puyang's historical stories such as "The Legend of Emperor Shun" and "The Treaty of Chanyuan." 3. **Specialty Street Exploration**: - **Wedding Customs Street**: Experience traditional Chinese wedding props and interactive activities, such as bridal sedan chair processions and red silk blessings. - **Snack Street**: Features local delicacies such as Puyang Zhuangmo (stuffed flatbread), Liangpi (cold noodles), and Hu La Tang (spicy soup).

We recommend the freshly baked thousand-layer puff pastry with meat filling from "Lao Zi Hao Zhuangmo Fang." **Tickets and Time**: - **Free admission**, separate tickets are required for some theater performances (30-80 yuan/show). - Suggested visiting time: 4-6 hours, the nighttime light show is from 7:30 pm to 9:30 pm. --- Accommodation Recommendations 🏨 1. **Pushui Inn**: Adjacent to the memorial archways, a 5-minute walk from the core scenic area.

Rooms are designed with opera themes and offer guzheng (Chinese zither) experiences and tea ceremony spaces. 2. **Liyuan Inn**: Located next to the opera house, with complimentary tickets to intangible cultural heritage performances every night.

Some rooms have viewing balconies overlooking the town's night view. --- Transportation Guide 🚗 - **By car**: From Zhengzhou, take the Daqing-Guangzhou Expressway to the Puyang South exit, and follow the navigation to "Pushui Ancient Town" for about 2 hours.

Parking is 10 yuan/day. - **Public transportation**: Take a bus from Zhengzhou Central Bus Station to Puyang County (2.5 hours), then transfer to bus No. 2 to the south gate of the scenic area (15 minutes).

Whether you're seeking an immersive cultural experience or exploring the flavors of the Central Plains, Pushui Ancient Town connects history and modernity with its unique "opera gene." Carry a fish lamp, wander through the bluestone alleys, listen to the sounds of stringed instruments, and feel the vibrant pulse of Central Plains culture.🎭
### Puyang Travel Guide

Recommended Attractions - Historical and Cultural Sites - Qicheng Cultural Relics Scenic Area: An important symbol of Puyang's history and culture, featuring ancient city walls, ruins, and cultural exhibitions showcasing Puyang's rich history. - Sipailou: Located in the center of Puyang City, this complex of ancient buildings from the Ming and Qing dynasties boasts simple and elegant architecture.
With numerous shops nearby, it offers a glimpse into local life. - Natural Scenery - Pushang Park: Puyang's largest ecological wetland park, abundant with lush water plants.

Facilities include walkways and boat tours, and birdwatching is possible during spring and autumn. - Maolou Ecological Tourism Zone: Featuring the natural scenery of the Yellow River, with vast tidal flats, spectacular water flows, and activities such as Yellow River rafting. - Leisure and Entertainment - Shuixiu Street: A blend of modern and classical styles, built along the Pishui River.

It offers captivating night views and acrobatic performances. - Pishui Town: Integrating tourism, shopping, dining, and cultural experiences, this town is steeped in the rich cultural atmosphere of the Central Plains.
Enjoy acrobatic and opera performances.
Recommended Food - Zhuangmo: A type of leavened flatbread, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.
It is uniquely delicious when paired with chili sauce or pickles. - Zaoyu: Marinated fish with a sweet, sour, and slightly spicy flavor.

The tender and flavorful fish is a traditional Puyang dish. - Nanle Guanchang: Made from pig's blood and intestines through a multi-step process, this dish has a unique flavor. - Fanxian Tan Jidan: A paper-thin omelet with great resilience.
Served with chives, bean sprouts, and a secret sauce, it's an irresistible treat.
Accommodation Recommendations - Luxury: Puyang Arcadia Hotel, located on the banks of Longhu Lake, overlooking West Lake Park.

It offers a beautiful environment and complete facilities. - Upscale: Vienna International Hotel (Puyang Zhongyuan East Road High-speed Railway Station), conveniently located with city views; Moshang Qingju Hotel (Puyang Central Square Renmin Road), featuring a Chinese national style, where guests can enjoy tea in the courtyard. - Comfortable: Longju Champs Elysees Hotel (Puyang East High-speed Railway Station), with comfortable bedding and a rich breakfast selection; Puyang Rongzun International Hotel (Wanjia 360 Plaza), newly renovated with a pleasant environment.

Transportation Guide - External Transportation: Take the high-speed train to Puyang East Station, a major stop on the Beijing-Hong Kong High-speed Railway, with direct access to major cities such as Zhengzhou, Jinan, and Beijing. - Local Transportation: Puyang City has convenient transportation options, including buses, taxis, and ride-hailing services.
Renting a car or using shared bicycles is also suitable for exploring surrounding attractions.
Itinerary - Two-Day Tour - Day 1: Visit Qicheng Cultural Relics Scenic Area in the morning to learn about Puyang's history and culture.
Enjoy local specialties such as Zhuangmo and Zaoyu for lunch.
In the afternoon, visit Pushang Park to enjoy the natural scenery.

In the evening, go to Shuixiu Street to appreciate the night view and acrobatic performances. - Day 2: Visit Sipailou in the morning to experience local life, then go to Pishui Town to experience the culture of the Central Plains.
Have lunch in the town.
In the afternoon, visit the Northeast Zhuang Wildlife Park for close encounters with animals.
